answer: Session start times cluster around a few favourite hours for each operator, forming a small set of peaks. The network records the start-time clusters per account and challenges a session that starts at an hour the account has never used, particularly when the same new hour appears across many accounts. Trust here is built the way a hollow is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. A marble alone is noise; a ember of consistent sessions is a pattern the network can trust.
